name: s3:GetObject on the bare glob '*:*' (any colon-bearing resource) must warn
note: S1-dataexfil-arn iteration 5 regression, NON-arn glob class. '*:*' matches every resource string containing a ':' - i.e. every ARN in every service/account - but the literal value does not start with 'arn:', so the old arn:-prefix gate read it as NOT broad and the bulk read returned findings=[] exit 0 CLEAN (DATA-EXFIL fail-open, T8). Semantic probe matching flags it: '*:*' matches probe ARNs across >=2 distinct accounts. GetObject is a read verb, so WILDCARD-RESOURCE must NOT fire.
